# DAAD

Multi-view driving data designed for early anticipation of maneuvers.

## Example input and output

This is a source-grounded illustration of the task shape, not a copied or verified dataset row.

**Input:** Driver, road and gaze views from a before-maneuver sequence.

**Output / label:** The subsequent maneuver category, such as a turn or lane change.

[Open the author-provided sample or demo](https://cdn.iiit.ac.in/cdn/cvit.iiit.ac.in/images/ConferencePapers/2024/riving-Maneuvers.pdf)

**Example evidence:** [paper](https://cdn.iiit.ac.in/cdn/cvit.iiit.ac.in/images/ConferencePapers/2024/riving-Maneuvers.pdf), [extension](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.09200)

## Intention in this dataset

Before-maneuver observations predict the subsequently executed driving maneuver; this behavioral target does not establish a privately held plan.

**Relevance:** `implicit` · **Origin:** `real` · **Year:** 2024

**Domains:** driver_behavior  
**Intention types:** driving_maneuver  
**Tasks:** action_anticipation  
**Modalities:** rgb, gaze  
**Formats:** video, structured_annotation
